Subject: Hosting evidence & Privatelink boundary — EU-only deployment

Hi Mateo,

We are preparing our third-party risk sign-off for an EU-only pilot and need a compact evidence packet showing Redwood's controls for PrivateLink/VPC-based deployments. Top asks from our InfoSec:

- A CAIQ/CSI slice that maps to network boundary controls (network interfaces, private endpoints, transit/egress restrictions).
- A network diagram showing PrivateLink/peerings and ingress/egress paths for EU nodes only.
- Keystore/KMS partitioning matrix (where customer KMS resides, whether we hold transitory keys).
- Ops runbook excerpts that demonstrate jurisdictional failover (what happens if a node is degraded and how we prevent cross-border failover).
- Any SOC 2 artifact references related to logical/physical separation for EU tenants.

We understand redactions are normal — provide redacted artifacts where appropriate. Can you confirm what you can share and the expected delivery timeline? Also please flag any items that require an NDA/DPPA before sharing.

Appreciate a single zip or Drive folder and a short index describing redactions.

Thanks,
Laura Huang
Head of Security, Orion Health
security@orionhealth.com

--
Attachment: orion_request_checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet with question rows)

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>

Cc: irene.choi@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 5 Jun 2025 13:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosting evidence & Privatelink boundary — EU-only deployment

Hi Laura — thanks for the clear list. We can produce an evidence packet that covers the bullets you listed. High level plan and constraints:

1) CAIQ/CAIQ-derived slice: we will produce a redacted PDF that maps controls for network boundary, encryption-in-transit, and multi-tenant separation. Expect a 2–3 page control matrix.

2) Network diagram: we'll include a PrivateLink diagram scoped to the EU region (nodes, VPC peering, NAT/egress gateways) and annotate ingress/egress lanes.

3) KMS/Keystore matrix: we will provide a CSV showing whether keys are customer-managed vs Redwood-managed for EU-dedicated and VPC configurations. Sensitive internal hostnames will be redacted.

4) Ops runbook: we can provide redacted excerpts demonstrating our failover decision tree and manual controls that prevent automatic cross-region promotion. We cannot share on-call phone numbers in the public packet.

5) SOC 2 references: we will reference SOC 2 sections (control IDs) and include a mapping doc; we cannot publish the full SOC 2 report without an executed NDA.

Delivery: preliminary packet (redacted) by Tue June 10; full artifacts under NDA (if required) within 3 business days after NDA signature.

Please confirm whether a one-way NDA is acceptable for the full SOC 2 and internal runbook excerpts, or if you prefer a mutual NDA. If you want us to upload the redacted packet to a temporary Drive link, we will do so.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai

--
Attachments referenced: redwood_privatelink_network_diagram.pdf (will be included), redwood_caiq_slice_redacted.pdf (will be included)

Folks — forwarding Laura's request. Key deliverables for the packet: CAIQ slice, EU-only PrivateLink diagram, KMS matrix, ops runbook excerpts, SOC 2 mapping. Redaction and NDA notes below.

Irene — can you own the CAIQ slice + SOC2 mapping? We need the control IDs that map to network isolation, tenant separation, and key management. Aim for a 2–3 page PDF. Mark anything that would be considered sensitive (internal hostnames, internal IP ranges) and suggest redaction language.

Ben — please pull the ops runbook excerpts that show failover gating logic and the step where cross-region promotion is explicitly blocked for EU tenants. Redact pager numbers and internal escalation usernames. We will provide a one-paragraph summary for public packet and a redacted excerpt for the Drive.

Marissa — prepare the network diagram and the KMS/keystore CSV for EU-only. For the CSV include columns: component, key-location (customer/redwood), kms-provider, kms-region, retention-notes. Avoid listing any customer keys.

NDA: Laura asked about NDA. We typically push for a mutual NDA for full SOC 2 documents. For now send the redacted packet without an NDA; hold SOC 2 artifact and internal runbook excerpts until we have a signed mutual NDA or an executed one-way agreement.

Deliverable deadline: June 10 (redacted packet). Internal deadline to me: June 9 COB.

Thanks — Mateo
